lanes.title: Quotient-hash cache reuse
lanes.mechanism: Retain the x-derived quotient hash in each walker and invalidate it only when the point changes.
lanes.target: strong_rho.rs Walker::h and the main walk loop
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Any cached and recomputed hash, partition, or final answer differs on a known-answer trajectory.
lanes.measurement_gate: Source-bound profile followed by isolated A/A and interleaved A/B on the composed binary.

lanes.title: Power-of-two partition mask
lanes.mechanism: Use h & (r-1) for power-of-two branch counts and retain modulo for every other count.
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Mask and h mod r disagree for any tested h and power-of-two r.
lanes.measurement_gate: Count-neutral source-bound wall comparison after the partition count is frozen.
lanes.status: integrated; 900000 partition cases passed in the range oracle [pcc:unverified]

lanes.title: Invariant reciprocal partition reduction
lanes.mechanism: Replace non-power-of-two h mod r with a precomputed exact reciprocal reduction while retaining modulo as oracle.
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Reciprocal reduction differs from h mod r on boundaries or deterministic random u64 inputs.
lanes.measurement_gate: Only an isolated wall gain on a preregistered non-power-of-two arm can admit it.
lanes.status: specified; no non-power-of-two primary arm is frozen

lanes.title: Look-ahead candidate-hash carry
lanes.mechanism: Carry the accepted candidate hash from batch look-ahead into the walker update instead of hashing the point twice.
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Carried and recomputed hashes differ or alter the trajectory/native hash count.
lanes.measurement_gate: Composed deterministic parity, then source-bound isolated wall comparison.

lanes.title: Stable active-lane retry compaction
lanes.mechanism: Compact pending look-ahead lanes into stable order without changing per-lane jump attempts or discarded-work accounting.
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Any lane selects a different jump, point, coefficient, retry count, or discarded operation.
lanes.measurement_gate: Complete walk cost must improve under every preregistered addition-price band or the trade must be reported.

lanes.title: Two-level retry slab
lanes.mechanism: Evaluate the first two retry levels together to reduce nonempty retry batches.
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Candidate raises complete counted cost or changes any trajectory field.
lanes.measurement_gate: A redesigned candidate must beat the composed baseline in complete cost before wall testing.
lanes.status: screened count-negative and excluded from production [pcc:unverified]

lanes.title: Lazy quotient sign
lanes.mechanism: Carry an orientation bit and defer coefficient/point negation while transitions operate on the canonical quotient representative.
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Eager and lazy quotient keys, partitions, DP decisions, cycle repeats, or recovered scalar differ.
lanes.measurement_gate: Elliptic-curve diagnostic arm with exact x/partition/DP trajectory, followed by isolated wall A/B.
lanes.status: cyclic-group state oracle passed; elliptic-curve arm not implemented [pcc:unverified]

lanes.title: Signed jump-table application
lanes.mechanism: Apply each canonical jump with the walker's deferred orientation so the quotient transition matches eager canonicalization.
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: After any transition lazy coefficients are not orientation times eager coefficients.
lanes.measurement_gate: Full elliptic-curve transition parity across the frozen deterministic panel.
lanes.status: 1048576 cyclic-group transitions passed; elliptic-curve arm not implemented [pcc:unverified]

lanes.title: Quotient-key cycle snapshots
lanes.mechanism: Store cycle snapshots by canonical quotient key and retain orientation-aware coefficient state separately.
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Eager and lazy walkers detect a repeated quotient state at different steps.
lanes.measurement_gate: Identical cycle counts, lengths, escape points, and final scalar in the elliptic-curve arm.
lanes.status: 1035705 repeated cyclic quotient states had parity; elliptic-curve arm not implemented [pcc:unverified]

lanes.title: Canonical-minimum cycle escape
lanes.mechanism: Return to the quotient cycle's canonical minimum before the escape addition so lane snapshot phase cannot split a merged walk.
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Equivalent snapshot phases escape to different quotient states.
lanes.measurement_gate: Known-answer exact trajectory plus multi-seed statistical rho-constant control if the transition changes.
lanes.status: integrated in the composed source; deterministic source selftest passed [pcc:unverified]

lanes.title: Distinguished predicate on quotient key
lanes.mechanism: Classify distinguished points from the sign-invariant x-derived hash and reuse that value for the table key.
lanes.target: strong_rho.rs DP test and table lookup
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Opposite representatives receive different DP decisions or table keys.
lanes.measurement_gate: Exact DP sequence/table-operation parity in the elliptic-curve diagnostic arm.
lanes.status: 1048576 eager/lazy DP decisions matched in the cyclic oracle [pcc:unverified]

lanes.title: Packed distinguished-point record
lanes.mechanism: Store only the canonical quotient key, coefficients, orientation, and provenance needed for replay and collision recovery.
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Packing loses enough information to replay a DP, distinguish sterile collisions, or recover the scalar.
lanes.measurement_gate: Byte-count and peak-RSS reduction plus unchanged collision replay on the matched panel.
lanes.status: specified; low priority on the q=223 control and not implemented

lanes.title: Single-probe DP table fusion
lanes.mechanism: Fuse distinguished lookup, sterile-collision classification, and insertion around one retained hash probe.
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Fused and baseline tables differ in insertion, collision pair, sterile count, or recovered scalar.
lanes.measurement_gate: Source-bound table-phase profile and isolated wall comparison; abstract table_ops stay unchanged.

lanes.title: Fully native-counter-free production walk
lanes.mechanism: Const-specialize NativeCounts updates out of the same mathematical walk body and separate native/field authority bits.
lanes.target: strong_rho.rs NativeCounts call chain, main.rs schema, analyzer authority checks, optimized-IR gate
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Any native-counter load/store/increment survives in the uncounted walk or mathematical output differs.
lanes.measurement_gate: Zero independent native-counter IR markers, then isolated counted-versus-counter-free wall diagnostics.

lanes.title: Structure-of-arrays walker state
lanes.mechanism: Split points, coefficients, cached hashes, tail state, and snapshots into aligned lane arrays without changing lane order.
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: AoS and SoA arms differ in any per-lane transition, retry, cycle, DP, collision, or answer.
lanes.measurement_gate: Profile-guided implementation followed by isolated A/A and A/B; no wall claim from layout alone.

lanes.title: Orientation-aware trajectory and collision oracle
lanes.mechanism: Independently verify quotient trajectory parity and solve collisions using both representatives' orientation signs.
lanes.target: standalone native verifier, then elliptic-curve replay validator
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: The orientation-normalized collision equation fails to recover the planted scalar or accepts a wrong scalar.
lanes.measurement_gate: Independent elliptic-curve replay of every lazy-sign matched-grid collision.
lanes.status: 79954 nonsterile cyclic collision equations recovered the planted scalar; elliptic-curve validator remains open [pcc:unverified]
